name: Jurassic Land
source:
“Jurassic Land” is a 3d graphic novel (+18) that tells the story of “LOGAN” a young man who finds himself on an island
where dinosaurs and other animals are dominating the world, Logan along with other humans must find a way to survive day after day.
translation: 《侏罗纪之地》是一部18+成人3D视觉小说，讲述年轻男子“洛根”流落一座由恐龙与其他猛兽主宰的孤岛，不得不与其他人类幸存者并肩协作、日复一日艰难求生的故事。
